title: UCAS-EDML: Target Leakage in Machine Learning Models that Predict Higher Education Graduation from Administrative Records
description: Reference implementation for a study of target leakage in machine-learning models that predict higher education graduation from administrative student records. Two attributes routinely held in student information systems — the recorded graduation year and the graduate grade average — are deterministic functions of the outcome; retaining them drives Decision Tree, Random Forest and Gradient Boosting to exactly 100% accuracy with zero cross-validation variance. The repository contains the leakage diagnostic, the corrected leakage-free pipeline (train/test split before scaling and augmentation), pre-enrolment prediction, and a fairness audit by recorded sex. Supersedes version 1.0.0, whose reported accuracy was an artefact of the leakage documented here. Data shipped with the repository is synthetic; the published results in results/ come from the full institutional dataset.
